scope.noop_role_status: NOOP is a fifth input operator, never a fifth query, output, active role, or repeated role.
scope.t6_scope_rule: No 750x or 760x artifact was used to decide T7 architecture; closed T6 evidence remains closed.

question_and_contract.question: For every non-empty active-role subset X of R, does inserting one known atomic NOOP clause preserve every present-role argument and prevent every absent role from appearing?
question_and_contract.input: X + NOOP(D), where X is a non-empty subset of R, each active role occurs at most once, and D is one argument value.
question_and_contract.output: Exactly four structured role outputs; each role emits its correct argument when present or NONE when absent.
question_and_contract.invariance: Output_R(X+NOOP(D)) = Output_R(X) for every role R in the fixed four-role output.
question_and_contract.noop_semantics: Known at atomic level, but never presented jointly with active clauses during the existing training recipe; not an unknown operator with an untrained embedding.

evidence.finding: Module is shared READ/COMPUTE/COMMIT API; training orchestration is explicitly left to a later change.
This module's opcode vocabulary contains no OP_NOOP; it is not the T6 RELKEY trainer/objective.

findings: Training rows are read from manifest train and accepted only when role is in ROLES={FLOOR,AVOID,MATCH,ANCHOR}.
Exactly 32 rows per existing role are required; total is 128.
FLOOR and AVOID receive behavior source rows; MATCH and ANCHOR append source_rows=-1 and skip behavior mapping.
No NOOP row, OP_NOOP token, NONE target, or fifth input operator is present in this batch builder.
Behavior loss consumes only FLOOR and AVOID indices.
Reference loss consumes the four role indices and their argument targets.
Separation loss is generic_separation over the existing manifest/catalog; current objective has no NOOP term, NONE target term, or OP_NOOP candidate.
d2_calibrate reads 128 atomic catalog scores and 40 background contexts only.
N_r^max is formed from other-role atomic scores and those background contexts; no NOOP score is consumed.
Stored threshold uses b_r=N_r^max+(P_r^min-N_r^max)/2 and strict float32 checks.
Fresh GenericNRoleBinder is trained on the four-role atomic batch with AdamW and the existing objective.
The decoder codebook is loaded/frozen, but this is not NOOP supervision.
No OP_NOOP row or NOOP-specific target enters training.
Historical T3 explicitly built 32 atomic NOOP rows with constraints=(0,0) source rows and no value target.
The row shape was [OP_NOOP, ARG_D], but this is T3 provenance, not T6 evidence.
objective computes noop_details but never uses them to build a target state.
Behavior uses all source rows with zero conditions for NOOP indices, so NOOP rows can affect the frozen supervisor's batch loss but are disconnected from NOOP encoder states.
Reference and separation losses use FLOOR/AVOID only; L_sep explicitly records noop_excluded=true.
Therefore T3 does not establish learned atomic NOOP binding; NOOP embedding receives no effective gradient from the shown objective path.
NOOP is a recognized ordinary token in the R1 vocabulary and tokenizer.
R1 parser permits NOOP VALUE_i as a clause and maps it to constraints=(0,0), but this parser is not the T6 four-role objective.
A future T7 input must treat OP_NOOP as normal token text, with no special active-set identifier delivered to the model.

stage_1_atomic_data.code_verdict: T6 has no such row. T3 had a NOOP atomic row but no value target; its effective NOOP encoder supervision was disconnected.

stage_2_objective.current_behavior: No effective NOOP encoder supervision; T6 behavior only indexes FLOOR/AVOID.
stage_2_objective.current_reference: No NOOP value target; current reference iterates four roles only.
stage_2_objective.current_separation: No OP_NOOP candidate in T6 catalog/background; no NOOP term.
stage_2_objective.current_classification: NOOP enters none of the current T6 objective paths.
stage_2_objective.required_future_decision: Define an explicit NOOP/NONE supervision term before any future training; do not emulate it host-side or call existing T6 loss an atomic NOOP loss.

stage_4_null_calibration.current_t6: b_r uses atomic four-role scores plus 40 base BG contexts; NOOP excluded.
stage_4_null_calibration.protocol_1: Use base T6 b_r unchanged; evaluate G_{r,new->NULL}=b_r-max_{z in U}s_r(z).
stage_4_null_calibration.protocol_2: Permit expanded negative catalog before test: N_{r,7}^max=max(N_{r,base}^max,max_{z in U}s_r(z)); b_{r,7}=N_{r,7}^max+(P_r^min-N_{r,7}^max)/2.
stage_4_null_calibration.status: Neither protocol executed or changed in this unit.

stage_5_inference.input_rule: OP_NOOP is ordinary token text in [OP_NOOP,ARG_D]; no special active-set identifier is supplied.
stage_5_inference.output_rule: The same four role queries run; each returns an argument or NONE.
stage_5_inference.known_token_condition: OP_NOOP must be represented in the model vocabulary/catalog for 'known' hypothesis; no unknown-token generalization claim is allowed.

mathematical_certificates.new_noop_absence_certificate: G_{r,nuevo->NULL}=b_r-max_{z in U}s_r(z)>0 for every r in R
mathematical_certificates.present_role_condition: For a present role, n_r(D)<s_r(target) is sufficient to keep NOOP below the target.
mathematical_certificates.absent_role_condition: For an absent role, n_r(D)<b_r is additionally required to keep NOOP below NULL.
mathematical_certificates.counterexample: b_r=2, n_r(D)=3, s_r(target)=6: present target wins, but absent role gets false positive because NOOP beats NULL.
mathematical_certificates.status: formula_and_implication_derived; no score evaluated and no checkpoint loaded
mathematical_certificates.coverage_condition: Positive G certificate is sufficient only conditional on grammar/candidate coverage and preservation of base T6 separation; it is not an experimental result.

protocol_1_transfer_unmodified_threshold.name: Transfer with NOOP outside calibration
protocol_1_transfer_unmodified_threshold.threshold_source: Base T6 b_r from atomic+40-BG catalog; do not include NOOP in calibration.
protocol_1_transfer_unmodified_threshold.question: Does the learned representation place every U candidate below each existing NULL threshold?

protocol_2_expanded_negative_calibration.name: Calibrate with NOOP negatives
protocol_2_expanded_negative_calibration.threshold_source: Include U before test and derive b_{r,7} from expanded N_{r,7}^max.
protocol_2_expanded_negative_calibration.question: Can explicit pre-test calibration reject NOOP distractors under the expanded catalog?

calibration_protocols.non_interchangeability_rule: Do not run protocol 1, observe failures, expand the catalog, and report protocol 2 as the same successful experiment. This unit changes neither calibrator nor objective.

future_evaluation_design.paired_unit: For each same semantic assignment, compare base X against X+NOOP(D); both outputs must be structurally complete, correct, and identical.
future_evaluation_design.required_comparison: Two equally wrong outputs do not establish useful invariance; correctness is required independently for both paired inputs.

metrics.absent_noop_false_positive: For k=1,2,3, count any absent role whose output changes from NONE or whose NOOP candidate beats NULL.
metrics.present_false_negative_or_change: For active roles, count target loss, pointer change, argument change, or output change from X to X+NOOP.
metrics.pointer_correct: Require pointer to correct target position, not merely correct decoded value.
metrics.raw_canon_and_complete: Require RAW/CANON equivalence and complete four-role structured result for both paired inputs.
metrics.position_order_invariance: Compare all allowed NOOP insertion positions and all (k+1)! orders for the same semantic assignment.
metrics.k4_absence: not_applicable; k=4 is binding-with-distractor control, not absent-role evidence.

verified_in_code: Current T6 training/objective/calibration contain no effective OP_NOOP supervision or NOOP candidate.
Historical T3 had NOOP atomic rows but its NOOP encoder state is disconnected from reference/separation supervision; it is not evidence of learned atomic NOOP binding.
R1 parser recognizes NOOP as ordinary token text with constraints=(0,0).
mathematical_derivations: 34 new candidates U = 32 OP_NOOP->ARG_D + START->OP_NOOP + LINK->OP_NOOP.
Absent-role safety requires NOOP below b_r, not merely below a present target.
A positive G_{r,new->NULL} certificate would conditionally establish NOOP below NULL without expanded calibration.
hypotheses_not_verified: Known atomic NOOP representation may spontaneously satisfy G_{r,new->NULL}>0 under transferred base thresholds.
A future explicit NOOP/NONE objective could provide effective supervision without changing four-query/four-output architecture.
Paired X versus X+NOOP outputs may remain invariant across all 260 configurations.
claims.blocking_decision: Before any T7 training campaign, choose and specify an effective NOOP/NONE supervision path; current T6 objective cannot support the claim.

halt.t7_status: Design only; no campaign execution authorized by this artifact.
halt.architecture_rule: Do not add a fifth query, fifth output, active-set input, lexical gate, repeated role, or C1 extension.
